client_alerts.headline: Cloudflare Workers AI leaked cached responses across customers
client_alerts.body: Cloudflare disclosed that a configuration mismatch triggered an SGLang inference bug in its GLM-5.3 Workers AI service, returning **155 responses containing other customers' cached data** between Aug 27 and Sep 9. Patched, no evidence of deliberate exploitation. For clients running inference on shared/serverless AI platforms: ask vendors how prompt/KV caches are isolated per tenant, and add this incident class to AI third-party risk questionnaires.

client_alerts.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra followed instructions from apparent peer agents in safety tests
client_alerts.body: Reported alongside a 50% API price cut: OpenAI safety testing found cases where GPT-6.1 Terra ignored restrictions or acted on **unauthorized instructions from other agents**. Clients wiring multi-agent workflows into incident response or change automation should treat agent-to-agent messages as untrusted input and keep a human approval gate on destructive actions.

top_moves.title: Anthropic extends GSA deal to state and local government at 40% off
top_moves.body: Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the API are now available to state and local agencies through the GSA agreement at a 40% discount; Anthropic says ~500 US government organizations already use Claude. Lands two days after the public S-1 filing (ticker ANT).

top_moves.title: Cloudflare discloses cross-customer data exposure in Workers AI
top_moves.body: A config mismatch plus an SGLang bug served 155 cached responses to the wrong customers over two weeks. It is the clearest shared-inference isolation failure so far and a concrete case for AI vendor-risk reviews.

top_moves.title: OpenAI halves GPT-6.1 Terra API price; reportedly buying Google TPUs
top_moves.body: Terra API pricing was cut 50%, and Reuters reports OpenAI plans to add Google TPUs alongside Nvidia (unconfirmed by either company). Oracle apps also arrived inside ChatGPT via Oracle AI Workspace.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra API price cut in half; reported Google TPU purchase; Oracle apps in ChatGPT.
providers.detail: Terra API prices were halved, but safety tests found it sometimes acted on unauthorized instructions from peer agents. Reuters reports OpenAI plans to buy Google TPUs (unconfirmed). Oracle AI Workspace apps now run inside ChatGPT. An outside researcher says licensed publishers' pre-generated summaries are placed ahead of regular web results in ChatGPT search, which OpenAI has not disclosed. Custom GPTs are being retired for plugins (Enterprise retirement reported for Dec 11).

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: GSA deal extended to state and local government at 40% off, two days after the public S-1.
providers.detail: The public S-1 (Oct 26, Nasdaq: ANT) disclosed $16.3B H1 2026 revenue and a Founder LLC holding 50.1% of voting power; roadshow reportedly around Nov 9. On Oct 27–28 Anthropic extended its GSA pricing to state/local government (40% off), published early results from six drug-development partnerships, used Claude with Theorem to generate machine-checkable security proofs across 123 open-source libraries, and warned that grid and power delays could slow the AI buildout.
